bio: Lead Developer at ServiStar Consulting and Resident Technical Design Professor

name: Rick Williams
bio: Game Development Consultant and Lan Line Games Founder. Unity Certified 3D generalist, Designer, Producer and Project Manager.

name: Christina-Marie Drake
bio: Founder of Moms in Gaming and Ghostpunch Games Recruiter. Almost a decade of experience in strategic initiatives, HR and recruitment coupled with a strong background in leadership and technology.

name: Alessandro Biollo
bio: Area VP, LatAm for XSolla. He has managed the internationalization of multiple video game titles from LatAm and has over 15 years of experience in the video game industry in North America and LatAm

name: Sybil Collas
bio: Creative Director, Senior Narrative Designer, Writer, D&I Consultant. Contributed to more than 40 projects over the past 10 years.

name: Renee Gittins
bio: Creative Director and Studio Head at Stumbling Cat, passionate advocate and connector for developers and diversity in the game industry, with a background that spans across engineering, design, and production.

name: Corina Diaz
bio: Marketing Director and Community Builder at Mighty Yell. Working social media producer, digital strategist & community manager with a focus on games, food, tech & entertainment media.

name: Viktor Blanke
bio: Viktor Blanke is an Art Director based in Stockholm, via Sydney and London. Currently working at Mojang Studios and previously with Paradox Interactive and EA DICE. He strongly believes in the potential for storytelling and unique experiences within games as a medium, and its capacity for inclusion, understanding and discovery.
